audit.root_cause: tevatron is pinned to git main only via `[tool.uv.sources]`, which isn't written into the wheel's metadata, so installers resolve the bare `tevatron` requirement to PyPI tevatron 0.1.0 (from 2022). That release has no `tevatron.retriever` subpackage.
audit.evidence: pyproject.toml:13 `"tevatron"` + :27-28 `[tool.uv.sources] tevatron = { git = ... }`; logs/freeze.log:177 `tevatron==0.1.0` (the only version on PyPI); utils/retriever.py:18 `from tevatron.retriever.arguments import ModelArguments`.
audit.irl_fix: Declare `tevatron @ git+https://github.com/texttron/tevatron.git@<sha>` directly in dependencies (allow-direct-references is already on), or vendor the needed retriever code.

audit.what: Query-load failure returns [] (an empty dataset, not dummy rows). The qrel fallback writes EMPTY files that nothing reads. Neither fired, and the module failed to import loudly.
audit.evidence: browsecomp_plus.py:398-400 `except Exception as e: logger.error(...); return tasks` (tasks=[]) → :237 Dataset.from_list(rows). retriever.py:189-194 writes '# ... EMPTY' qrel files; QREL_* are referenced only in retriever.py and utils/__init__.py exports. probe import_error: "No module named 'tevatron.retriever'".
audit.user_impact: Loud failure today. If HF were unreachable, users would get a 0-row env (likely an error downstream [INFERENCE]) rather than fake scores. Requires a judge API key.
